The 2021 German national vote, taking place on September 26th, triggered a major realignment in the political scene, causing many Bundestag members — the lower chamber of Germany's legislature — to lose their positions.  Exactly 121 representatives from various political groups were ousted, signaling a deeply divided public and the ascent of the Greens and Free Democrats.  Examining the exact people who saw their seats revoked offers important clarity on the election's outcomes and the evolving patterns in German political life.

The Christian Democratic Union (CDU), long the leading force in Germany, saw its worst setbacks.  Kevin Kühnhold, a key member of the "New CDU," a newer, more progressive group, kept his position in Berlin, yet the party overall endured major setbacks.  Former CDU members such as Hans-Christian Strache, who once led Carinthia, and Frank Weise, who earlier stood for the North Sea islands, were also unseated.  These exits marked a powerful signal to the CDU’s traditional supporters and exposed the party’s difficulty in adjusting to shifting demographics and public worries.

The Social Democratic Party (SPD), headed by Chancellor Olaf Scholz, also experienced major setbacks.  A number of seasoned members of parliament, such as established figure Franz Müntefering, retired after long years in leadership, reflecting a shift in the party’s leadership structure.  Additional significant exits featured Stefan Weise, who served in Schleswig-Holstein, and Uwe Grimm, from the Hamburg area.  These departures were mainly due to public frustration over the SPD’s response to the energy downturn and escalating daily expenses.

The Alternative for Germany (AfD), a right-wing populist group, experienced a major rise in its influence, leading to multiple members of parliament being removed from their positions.  This involved Markus Sommer, once elected from Lower Saxony, and Björn Ohle, who served in Brandenburg.  The AfD’s achievements were especially visible in eastern Germany, a region where traditional conservative parties had faced difficulties.

The Greens saw major increases, and many of their past members failed to keep their positions.  This spanned Annalena Baerbock, the party’s co-leader, who struggled greatly in Wunsiedel.  Other Green MPs who lost their seats were Petra Köpping and Dirk Kutscher.  The party’s rise stemmed from their dedication to climate action and nature-related concerns, appealing strongly to a younger voting group.

The Free Democratic Party (FDP), that joined a governing alliance with the Greens and SPD, also witnessed several of its members lose their seats.  Nevertheless, the party’s overall result was markedly better than expected, solidifying its position in the new administration.  Key exits from the FDP comprised Michael Kraemer, who served in Hesse, and Christian Freimann, once elected for the Frankfurt area.

Ultimately, a number of minor parties, such as the Left (Die Linke) and Alliance 90/The Greens, also saw their support decline. The broader outcome of the vote marked a shift in German political dynamics, positioning the Greens and FDP as central forces, while the CDU and SPD entered a phase of reassessment and internal discussion.

Emotional shock in seniors involves prolonged distress and mental impairments that emerge after encountering terrifying or hazardous incidents, even when no serious bodily harm occurred. Compared to younger people, older individuals might encounter special difficulties in coping with trauma because of chronic illnesses, reduced mental adaptability, and loneliness. These experiences can show up as feelings of worry, sadness, trouble sleeping, and lapses in memory, often worsened by natural brain shifts with age. The effects of earlier traumas—like conflict, mistreatment, or the death of a partner—might reappear during major life shifts, such as leaving work or being admitted to a hospital. Seniors might also find it hard to reach or use mental wellness services because of shame, ignorance, or physical constraints. Studies reveal that trauma reactions can be both personal and passed down through families, shaped by inherited patterns and cultural beliefs. Successful treatments usually need customized methods, such as CBT modified for memory loss or peer-based group activities. Spotting issues early and maintaining contact with mental health experts is vital for better results and stronger emotional health in this group.

Henry William Brewer (1828–1907) was a leading British trader, vessel operator, and charitable figure, chiefly celebrated for his major support of the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland and his role in shaping Dublin’s seafaring facilities. Born in Liverpool in 1828 to a family deeply rooted in the city’s vibrant commerce, his formative years were defined by the pulses of the docks and the pressures of maritime transport. His father, William Brewer, was a profitable ship operator focusing on Baltic and North Sea routes, and young Henry early on pursued this family tradition, joining the family’s shipping enterprise at a young age.

Brewer's main operation focused on timber and coal trading, gradually growing the family's fleet to encompass ships carrying these goods. He stood out due to smart business strategies and an openness to new technology in the sector. Particularly, he was an early adopter of steam power, seeing how it could greatly boost efficiency and velocity over old sailing ships. This vision enabled the Brewer shipping firm to stay ahead in a rapidly changing global trade environment.

Nevertheless, Brewer's impact goes well beyond his business activities. Starting in the 1870s, he emerged as a major supporter of the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland, founding the Brewer Wing in 1883. This architectural gem, a neo-Gothic building conceived by William Martin Fagan, still stands as a key feature along Dublin’s O’Connell Street and functioned mainly as a lecture space and exam area for the College. His substantial contributions, amounting to over £100,000 back then – an undeniably large amount – played a vital role in ensuring the College’s survival and enabling its expansion.

Moreover, Brewer was central to shaping Dublin’s port infrastructure. He poured substantial resources into building and upgrading the North Wall quay, a crucial route for vessel movement. Understanding how vital smooth port functions were, he pushed for modernization and aimed to reduce bottlenecks, playing a major part in boosting Dublin’s seafaring capabilities.

Brewer’s private affairs stayed mostly untouched, yet he gained recognition for his deep involvement in charitable work and his steadfast backing of the arts. He passed away in 1907, bequeathing a multifaceted and significant legacy marked by business triumph, generous support for architecture, and a clear dedication to improving Dublin’s seafaring and medical fields. His efforts remain felt now, especially via the still-standing Brewer Wing at the Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland.

West Dunbartonshire Council has obtained a sum of £500,000 to revive the historic Dumbarton Academy structure, a decision the council describes as safeguarding one of the town's most identifiable features. The council has long sought funds for the building's rehabilitation, and the grant represents a major advancement in initiating that effort.

Officials stated the repair would protect the structure's integrity and create fresh opportunities for community organizations and tourists. The councillors praised the news, noting it came after extensive efforts by staff members. Information about the initiative—such as the schedule and overall expense—will be made public after the council completes its discussions with investors and the design group.

Dumbarton, an old burgh along the River Clyde, boasts a deep connection to shipbuilding and the castle perched on volcanic stone above the town. Advocacy organizations claim that refurbishing public structures can boost tourism and foster community pride. Since the edifice is located in the heart of the town, its state is keenly observed by locals.

Alex Lees, leading player of Yorkshire's limited-overs squad, has delivered a formal apology following a critical remark about a call by referee Martin Saggers in a recent fixture. The event took place in a domestic one-day match when Lees voiced his discontent with the on-field ruling, calling it "awful." This statement was broadcast in real time, sparking an immediate reaction from both the team and cricket regulators.

Lees, having guided Yorkshire in one-day events, stated in a declaration that he mourned the manner and substance of his comments. "I sincerely regret the speech I made regarding the choice. It was offensive and out of place, particularly within a team setting. I accept full accountability for how I conveyed myself and I am sorry to the umpire, to the athletes, and to the cricket world."

The ruling at issue pertained to the removal of a batter based on game regulations, with Saggers asserting the ball was not delivered as required by the rules. The judgment was subsequently questioned by athletes and spectators, with several claiming it could have been affected by outside influences. Nevertheless, the overseeing authority has not initiated any additional review.

Cricket Australia, responsible for domestic events in England, has still not released an official declaration. Nevertheless, the event has ignited conversations regarding communication protocols during live games and the necessity of upholding professionalism in public appearances.

Lees, an experienced athlete boasting more than 100 first-class matches, has long earned recognition for his guidance and calmness. This event represents a uncommon shift from his typical behavior. During another chat, he stated he was "deeply engaged with the match" and thought the remark was simply a personal slip, not an indication of his stance on the game.

The game carried on following the incident, and no additional fines or consequences have been disclosed. Yet, commentators have pointed out that it serves as a wake-up call for athletes to stay courteous during public talks, especially about how referees make calls.

Saggers has not replied to inquiries for clarification, yet he has earlier conveyed his dedication to preserving the game's authenticity and ensuring neutrality in every call. The event is expected to be examined by the coaching group during future meetings.

Currently, Lees is concentrating on progress. "I hope my decisions show the spirit of cricket—equity, dignity, and integrity," he stated. "Those principles are my goal, whether I'm playing or working outside the game."

The query floated in the atmosphere following the latest humanitarian disaster in the inundated part of Eldoria. Staff members, drained and burdened, started confronting not only the urgent requirements of uprooted households, but also a more profound, troubling question: what are we genuinely prepared to give up to ease pain?

New accounts suggest volunteers are giving up large shares of their earnings to buy essentials and move survivors to secure areas. A doctor, a widower with two children, confessed to selling his prized vehicle to pay for a short-term medical station. Yet, the emotional burden remains the hardest strain on numerous individuals.

A number of field staff have shared one-on-one about the toll on their private bonds, driven by constant immersion in distress and the weight of daily duties. "Time is the most precious thing you might forfeit," remarked Sarah Jenkins, a volunteer coordinator, "It’s simple to contribute funds, but to surrender your evenings, your weekends, your personal life… that’s a deep pledge."

The state in Eldoria reveals a troubling fact: the price of kindness may exceed early estimates, compelling people to face their most fundamental beliefs.

The Fontainebleau Forest spans a vast area roughly 60 kilometres east-southeast of Paris, famed for its sandstone formations, clearly marked paths, and its enduring connection to royal hunting activities. This region encompasses a significant expanse of broadleaf and mixed forests, and has remained conserved and overseen for hundreds of years as part of the royal lands surrounding the Fontainebleau palace.

A walk through the woods typically moves along set trails, steep slopes and wide spaces, allowing guests to spot the unique sandstone structures that define the terrain. These stones, born from old sand layers, take on many forms, a few smooth, others with level tops, and several group together beneath the foliage. The roughness and grain of their surfaces have earned the region a reputation among hikers, who visit to challenge themselves on stones of different sizes and levels of difficulty.

Paths winding through the woods have evolved over decades, and the system of trails is cared for by government bodies and community volunteers. Signs, explanation panels, and directional markers assist tourists in choosing their path, and certain zones are set aside for specific uses to preserve nature and the forest’s balance. Guests are encouraged to stick to the outlined routes and to refrain from harming the plants or stone walls.

In the past, the woods served as a hunting area for French monarchs, and the paths and open spaces were designed to support the royal pursuit. Numerous trails today still bear witness to that era, and tourists may frequently spot remnants of ancient limits, stone posts, and vehicle paths once used by the royal family. The chateau at Fontainebleau, featuring its landscaped grounds and exhibition halls, stands as a significant site and is typically explored alongside the forest.

From a natural standpoint, the woods hosts various flora and fauna that thrive in its blend of trees, open grassy areas, and loose soil. A few of the species on the rocky surfaces have evolved to survive in arid, low-nutrient environments, and the areas are watched closely for shifts triggered by people, weather patterns, and illnesses. Efforts in preservation strive to ensure that visitors can enjoy the space while still safeguarding the ecosystem.

Everyone organizing a trip must review the latest access policies, the forecast, and trail status prior to departure, since certain paths might be shut down for repairs or to safeguard bird nests and other animals. Publications from regional tourism departments list the top-used paths, and these often suggest proper gear and precautions.

Taiwo Ajai-Lycett is a British scholar, cultural expert, and public thinker recognized for her research in African history, postcolonial theory, and the cultural roots of the African diaspora. Raised in London with a Nigerian father and a British mother, she has consistently contributed to conversations on African identity, tradition, and the significant roles Black individuals have played in world history. Her education lies in history, concentrating on African societal development, the impact of colonial rule, and the transformation of cultural practices throughout Africa and its dispersed communities.

Ajai-Lycett possesses a PhD in History from Oxford University, where her dissertation explored the societal and political shifts in Yoruba communities throughout the 1800s. This research formed the basis for her subsequent writings, which highlight the enduring nature of African cultural traditions and systems even amid colonialism and enslavement. She has written widely in peer-reviewed journals and public discussions, maintaining a steadfast commitment to presenting historical knowledge in an accessible form for wider audiences.

Her writings feature multiple books and essays that examine where history, culture, and identity meet. A key contribution is *The Orisha in the Diaspora: A Cultural History*, which maps how Yoruba religious customs spread across the Atlantic. Within this book, she claims that African spiritual and ceremonial traditions have not only endured but developed in the diaspora, influencing the cultural makeup of groups in the Caribbean, the United States, and elsewhere.

Beyond her scholarly work, Ajai-Lycett has taken part in public learning projects, such as talks at universities throughout the UK and global gatherings on African topics. She regularly partners with cultural organizations to create programs that showcase African impact in global arts, writing, and science. Her initiatives have transformed the way African history is delivered and seen in British schools and wider public conversation.

Ajai-Lycett is equally a passionate champion for integrating African viewpoints into major historical accounts. She has addressed audiences about the value of honoring non-Western knowledge systems and resisting Eurocentric approaches to history. In her instruction, publications, and public events, she keeps motivating a rising wave of researchers and learners to explore African history as a vibrant, complex area of inquiry.

The Highland Council is progressing with a major tech overhaul, revealing a deal with WIPRO Holdings UK Ltd to oversee its IT systems. This decision, ratified by councillors last week, will assign WIPRO the duty of handling a broad spectrum of council tech functions, simplifying workflows and possibly cutting down ongoing upkeep expenses.

A central part of the deal involves gradually introducing tablet computers to schools throughout the area. The board intends to give students access to these tools to improve education and foster digital skills. Information about the exact models and programs involved in the project remains under development, yet the objective is to create a stable and dependable digital classroom setting.

The agreement, worth an unshared amount, will last for the first three years and include chances to extend. Leaders in the council think the collaboration with WIPRO will offer significant knowledge and tools to the Highland region. They expect the initiative will support the council’s performance and, especially, improve learning results for students across the area. More details about the schedule will be made public within the next few weeks.

Simplification is the intentional reduction or bending of a system within a scientific framework, carried out to make the model manageable, computable, or verifiable. In the philosophy of science, this idea lies at the heart of debates on how models connect to reality, since the majority of models omit real-world characteristics and occasionally introduce assumptions that are proven incorrect.

A well-known case is the frictionless surface in traditional mechanics. Learners begin by studying how a mass moves on a sloped surface with no friction, and only after that do they explore the impacts of friction, air drag, and actual surfaces' unevenness. This reduced scenario isn't simply wrong; it's a method that highlights a specific cause-and-effect link and renders its outcomes easier to understand.

Thinkers have identified various forms of simplification. Galilean simplification includes beliefs that are deliberately incorrect yet serve to reveal the core traits of a process, with the plan that further elements can be added later. On the other hand, a concept known as Aristotelian simplification means removing certain aspects of a system to examine a type of entity in its unaltered state, without claiming that the omitted features don't exist in reality.

The difference is crucial when discussing explanation and the nature of scientific laws. If a model relies on simplified assumptions, it becomes vital to consider whether the explanation it offers applies to actual systems, and in which situations it might break down. Certain authors claim that idealized models can still account for real-world occurrences by exposing the fundamental structure behind them, whereas others remain doubtful about the reliability of such explanations.

A different issue lies in de-idealization, where the basic premises of a model are slowly loosened to generate more accurate forecasts. Supporters claim this method demonstrates how simplified theories can link up with real-world complexity, while opponents note that the process is seldom easy and might involve arbitrary modifications.

Idealization has likewise been explored in sociology and economic theory, where frameworks of logical actors or fully competitive systems depend strongly on premises that are widely recognized as false. Discussions in these fields typically center on whether such frameworks serve practical purposes in forecasting, guidance, or comprehension, and on the validity of their foundational beliefs. These inquiries tie into broader concerns about model function in science, such as how they depict reality, how they are tested, and how their boundaries ought to be shared.

Pietro di Porto si presenta come un nome significativo nel panorama culturale e storico della zona meridionale dell’Italia, soprattutto nel sud del paese, dove le tradizioni locali e i pensatori hanno sempre mantenuto un ruolo fondamentale. Nato a Porto, cittadina del territorio pugliese, Pietro di Porto si colloca tra una serie di studiosi che hanno tentato di unire il pensiero antico alle esigenze del tempo attuale. Non è un nome ampiamente riconosciuto nell’ambito accademico mondiale, ma nel suo territorio di origine ha acquisito una certa notorietà grazie a scritti dedicati alla storia locale, alla letteratura e alla formazione dei giovani. I suoi testi, scritti in un linguaggio chiaro e profondo, esprimono un’attenta cura per le radici culturali della provincia, il ruolo del paesaggio nel plasmare l’identità e la necessità di un’educazione che vada oltre il sapere teorico. Ha lavorato in collaborazione con istituzioni locali per promuovere la scuola e il patrimonio storico. Non ha mai realizzato opere con carattere internazionale, ma il suo effetto si è visto in una vasta rete di insegnanti e studenti che hanno trovato ispirazione nelle sue riflessioni. La sua figura è quindi più un esempio di impegno civile che di produzione accademica, incarnando un’idea di conoscenza legata alla comunità e alla terra.

The issue of family nutrition is intricate, frequently simplified to economic and access factors. Nevertheless, a new study, released in recent weeks, raises a troubling and deeply rooted concern: poorer families do not eat worse simply because food is expensive or hard to locate, but because they deliberately opt for less healthy choices. The research, carried out by a group of scientists from the University of Bologna, has uncovered a psychological and cultural mechanism that shapes these families' food decisions, regardless of their income level.

Lo studio si fonda su un'ampia indagine sul campo effettuata in diverse aree del paese, parlando a centinaia di famiglie a basso stipendio. Gli scoperti hanno evidenziato che la mancanza di informazioni precise sulle alimentazioni e l'assenza di conoscenza riguardo a cibi più salutari hanno un peso significativo nelle scelte di compra. Invece di ciò che spesso si afferma, la semplice carenza di denaro non è l'unico fattore che porta a una dieta scarsa e sproporzionata.

L'approccio metodologico dell'indagine si è focalizzato sull'esaminare le abitudini alimentari consolidate, i piaceri preferiti e la percezione delle famiglie riguardo al cibo. È emerso che le famiglie a basso reddito tendono ad acquistare e a mangiare con regolarità alimenti ad alto apporto calorico, ricchi di zuccheri, grassi saturi e sale, come merendine pronte, dolci, piatti già cucinati e bevande zuccherate. Non si tratta di una mancanza di opzioni salutari, ma di una preferenza per quelle meno vantaggiose.

The reasons behind these choices are varied and deeply linked. Many parents, due to limited education or limited access to accurate nutritional information, fail to grasp the value of a balanced diet. Equally important is the influence of habits, often established early in life and passed down from one generation to the next. A child raised on foods high in sugar and fat will likely continue to favor such items, even as an adult.

Moreover, the lack of time, caused by rotating shifts or the duty of looking after children, often leads to hasty and simple decisions, favoring convenience over well-being. Buying ready-made foods, seen as faster and easier to prepare, is a direct result of this time shortage.

The research also highlights how food turns into a source of comfort and enjoyment, especially during economic hardship. Eating sweets or snacks might serve as a minor indulgence, a break from daily routines and stress.

The consequences of these findings are significant. Addressing the diets of low-income families does not merely call for financial assistance, but also targeted nutritional education programs, deliberately crafted to reshape eating habits and preferences, encouraging access to healthy and affordable foods. A multi-dimensional strategy is essential to tackle the root causes of the issue, acknowledging that food choices are deeply shaped by psychological, cultural, and social factors.

Il diritto ottomano è l'insieme di norme che governava la vita dell'impero ottomano, un stato plurietnico e plurireligioso che si sviluppò per secoli in Europa, Asia e Africa settentrionale. Il sistema giuridico si basava su diverse fonti che coesistevano e si complementavano tra loro. La prima era la sharia, la legge religiosa islamica, interpretata dai giuristi e applicata soprattutto nei settori del diritto familiare, della successione e dei riti religiosi. Accanto a essa, il sultano emetteva il kanun, una normativa di tipo pubblico che regolava l'amministrazione, le tasse, l'esercizio del potere e i rapporti tra lo stato e i cittadini. Il kanun aveva un ambito specifico, separato dallo spirituale, e permetteva di rispondere alle esigenze di un impero complesso, dove la legge doveva adattarsi ai territori e alle popolazioni diverse. Nelle città e nei paesi, la giustizia era gestita dai qadi, giudici che risolvevano le controversie secondo la legge religiosa e le abitudini locali, e le loro decisioni potevateri essere riviste in tribunali superiori. Un elemento distintivo del sistema era il regime delle comunità religiose, detto millet, che conferiva ai gruppi non musulmani, come il cristiano ortodosso e l'ebraico, un'ampia autonomia nelle questioni personali, come matrimonio, divorzio e eredità. Con il Tanzimat, la fase di riforme avviata nel 1839, lo stato cercò di codificare e modernizzare il diritto, introducendo codici di tipo europeo, come il codice commerciale e quello penale, mentre la sharia rimaneva in vigore per il diritto familiare. La Mecelle, codice civile pubblicato alla fine degli anni Settanta dell'Ottocento, costituì un tentativo di organizzare le norme del diritto privato sulla base della giurisprudenza islamica. Questo passaggio, insieme alle riforme successive, segnò la progressiva evoluzione verso un ordinamento più vicino ai modelli europei, pur conservando tracce profonde della tradizione giuridica precedente.

The unmanageable form of the infiltrator stands at the crosspoint of strategy, secrecy, and risk, embodying an agent trained to achieve delicate goals within hostile organizations or groups, remaining unseen and unacknowledged. The infiltrator doesn’t function just by being present, but by fully adapting to the environment, absorbing the way others think, their routines, rituals, and communication patterns. Its effectiveness comes from a deep mastery of observation, listening, and detecting hidden signals. It is not merely a passive observer of reality, but an entity in constant evolution, dissolving into its surroundings before reappearing as a force of influence. The tools of operation are varied: from language to the physics of movement, from the body to silence. Infiltration is not an act of force, but a performance of positioning, an art of presenting a presence that cannot be identified. Its very existence is a form of dissolution, a deliberate metamorphosis. The infiltrator multiplies in the implicit, operates in silence and within the intricacies of human relationships. Its end is not always known, and often its truth stays hidden, like a secret that requires no revelation.

Amazon sta crescendo in un campo imprevisto: la salute del bambino. Il colosso del commercio online ha rivelato la nascita di "Elements", una nuova gamma di articoli per i piccoli che vede tra i suoi elementi pannolini, detergenti e tovole idratate, tutti disponibili con il logo Amazon.

The move is part of a broader plan to manage the supply chain and boost profit margins, pushing Amazon beyond mere third-party sales. Elements aims to directly challenge established brands in the industry, delivering products that seem equally matched in quality and price.

The launch of the service met varied responses. Some users are thrilled about buying children's items straight from Amazon, valuing the convenience and savings offered by the advertised deals. Others, however, express concern over possible reduced options and the risk of being pushed to purchase Amazon products.

The outcome of Elements will hinge on Amazon's ability to present competitive prices, uphold product quality, and build trust with parents. The infant care market is famously responsive to price and brand credibility, both of which Amazon must prioritize to establish itself in this fresh domain. It remains uncertain whether this move will mark the start of a genuine transformation in the industry.

La pratica alfa-beta è un metodo di accelerazione utilizzato nell'intelligenza artificiale per diminuire il numero di nodi analizzati da un algoritmo di ricerca competitivo. È principalmente applicata ai metodi minimax, usati nei giochi tra due giocatori con informazione completa, come gli scacchi o la dama, dove ognuno cerca di aumentare il proprio punteggio e ridurre quello dell'altro. Il principio fondamentale prevede la conservazione di due parametri, alfa e beta, che indicano rispettivamente il massimo punteggio assicurato al giocatore che cerca il massimo e il minimo punteggio garantito al giocatore che cerca il minimo. Se durante l'esame di un ramo si scopre che tale ramo non può alterare la scelta già fatta, l'analisi si termina, senza modificare il risultato finale. In casi ottimali, con un ordine delle mosse ben scelto, il numero di nodi esaminati può diminuire notevolmente, permettendo di raggiungere una maggiore profondità entro lo stesso periodo di tempo. Questa tecnica, creata negli anni Cinquanta e Sessanta, è diventata un elemento essenziale nei motori di gioco. Il suo andamento si basa sulla precisione della funzione di valutazione e sull'ordine con cui vengono esaminate le mosse, due aspetti che influiscono direttamente sull'efficacia reale della ricerca.

Hai riaperto gli occhi e il sole non si è ancora spostato. Il frigo emette ancora il rumore del ghiaccio, il divano resta coperto di coperte. La finestra, sfuggita per un istante, ha permesso l'ingresso di un'aria che non si ricorda. Hai letto il giornale e l'hai deposto su un tavolo che non è più il tuo. L'acqua del rubinetto ha ancora quel gusto di estate, ma non c'è più nessuno che ne parla.

You've swept the news aside, like leaves drifting out of reach. Time stalled at a midpoint, between farewell and departure. Yesterday's figures still flicker on the screen, yet no one has stared at them. The empty square has resumed its emptiness, as if the world chose to stay silent.

Hai notato un uomo che si muove con l'atteggiamento di chi non ha più bisogno di un rifugio. Il bar è aperto, ma nessuno vi entra. Il telefono ha ancora riprodotto un suono, ma non ha più risposto.

Hai pensato a quel che era accaduto prima di oggi, prima che tu riapparissi. E poi hai realizzato: era semplicemente una domanda che non richiedeva una risposta.

Julia Sweeney è un esempio significativo della comicità statunitense, riconosciuta per il suo tono autoironico, la sua trasparenza e la sua partecipazione ai temi sociali. Nata il 14 febbraio 1959 a Seattle, Washington, Sweeney ha avviato la sua carriera nel mondo del teatro, collaborando con il Groundlings, un gruppo di improvvisazione prestigioso che ha formato numerose personalità del mondo della comicità. L'esperienza con i Groundlings le ha permesso di formare un approccio comico che si fonda sull'improvvisazione e sulla risposta alle situazioni.

La sua reputazione è scoppiata negli anni '90 per il suo episodio in *SCTV*, dove ha interpretato la controversa e risoluta Sheila Broome, un personaggio che esprimeva la sua abilità di affrontare argomenti nascosti con ironia e debolezza.  Il suo prestigio è cresciuto grazie alla creazione della commedia *Un’americana*, scritta e recitata completamente da lei, un’opera autobiografica che analizza la sua giovinezza, il rapporto con la madre, una vecchia protestante estrema, e la sua posizione come donna e cattolica.

Beyond her comedic work, Sweeney remains engaged as a political advocate and has fervently backed the movement for women's rights, especially during the 2004 election cycle, when she ran as a senatorial candidate under the independent label. Her blunt manner and dedication to tackling intricate issues have made her a respected and admired presence in both American political and cultural arenas.

Albinen è un paese in quota nel Canton Vallese, in Svizzera, posizionato in una valle secondaria che si estende verso Leuk. Il centro abitato, intorno alla chiesa parrocchiale, è formato da edifici in legno e pietra che mantengono l'architettura classica delle zone alpine, con coperture inclinate e stalle sostenute da pilastri. Per molti secoli l'economia del luogo si è basata sull'agricoltura alpina, sull'allevamento e sulla gestione forestale, attività che hanno plasmato il paesaggio dei pendii a terrazza e dei prati di alpeggio. Nel Novecento la popolazione si è ridotta grazie all'emigrazione verso i centri in bassa valle e verso le città svizzere, mentre il turismo ha creato nuove possibilità legate ai percorsi escursionistici, all'ospitalità country e alla vendita di beni locali. Il paese conserva ancora alcune usanze connesse alle stagioni dell'alpeggio e alle festività religiose, che coinvolgono ancora la comunità in eventi pubblici. Ora Albinen fa parte di un territorio che valorizza il patrimonio costruito e i prodotti alpini, cercando un equilibrio tra tradizione e sviluppo turistico.

Pomigliano, durante i giorni del voto, non disse mai nulla. Non ci fu nessuno che si esprimeva nelle strade, nei palazzi, nei balconi. Nessun sindaco si alzò, nessun gruppo si riunì, nessun annuncio, nessuna parola che si diffondesse. Il silenzio non era banale, era opprimente. I cittadini camminavano, fissavano il cielo, ascoltano le radio, ma non si sentivano compresi. Le strade erano deserte, i mercati chiusi, le scuole inattive. L’ansia si diffondeva, ma non si trasformava in azione. C’erano persone che si chiedevano cosa stesse avvenendo, perché nessuno spiegava. I gruppi che si erano formati si disperse come nebbia. C’era un’impressione di abbandono, come se il tempo fosse bloccato. Le discussioni si arrestavano al primo punto. Nessuno si faceva sentire, nessuno si pronunciava. Il voto era un fatto, ma il dibattito? Non c’era. Solo la routine, la vita quotidiana, come se nulla fosse cambiato. Eppure, quel giorno, c’era stato qualcosa di profondo, di invisibile, che si rifiutava di essere visto. Il popolo non si è sentito rappresentato. Il silenzio ha vinto. E nel silenzio, si è persa la possibilità di dire qualcosa di vero.

Bill Cunningham non era semplicemente un fotografo della moda. Era un occhio invisibile, un osservatore attento e, per tanti, un compagno. La sua fine, avvenuta sabato all’età di 87 anni, lascia un vuoto enorme nel panorama culturale di New York e nel mondo della moda. Per quarant’anni, le vie della città erano state il suo studio, e le persone che camminavano su di esse, i suoi temi preferiti.

The work, beginning at the New York Times in 1981, was a kind of reporting unlike any other. Cunningham showed no interest in flashy celebrities or high-end runways. His realm covered the "real people" of New York, individuals who moved with a natural grace and undeniable beauty, often overlooked by conventional fashion circles. His photos captured daily life, spontaneous portraits of men and women dressed in all sorts of styles, from luxury to vintage, from plain to refined.

Cunningham period noto per la sua umiltà e il suo profondo know-how sulla vita cittadina. Non richiedeva autorizzazioni, non usava metodi di posa sofisticati. Si limitava a aspettare, con la sua vecchia macchina fotografica Minolta, fino a quando un soggetto gli si presentava, un’armonia di colori, texture e stile che valeva la pena catturare. A volte si avvicinava a individui senza annunciare nulla, invitandoli a indossare un capo che gli pareva particolare, e poi, in pochi istanti, trasformava un incontro informale in un'opera d'arte.

His legacy extends far beyond the thousands of images he captured. Cunningham was a champion of "slow fashion", a philosophy that urged people to buy high-quality, long-lasting, and versatile clothing, rather than chasing fleeting trends. Frequently, via his writings in the New York Times, he spotlighted rising designers and unknown talents, giving them a stage to gain visibility.

La sua passione era totale. Per quasi quattro decadi, Cunningham operò senza interruzioni, molte volte addormentandosi nel suo studio al giornale e trascorrendo la vita su un regime scarseggiante composto da pane tostato e caffè. Il suo studio era un disordine ordinato, un deposito di abiti, sciarpe, cappelli e oggetti recuperati dal pavimento, raccolti da ogni strada di New York. Era un archivio in movimento della moda urbana, un patrimonio di stili e personalità.

Despite his fame, Cunningham stayed deeply modest and reserved. He seldom spoke about himself, opting instead to let his photographs speak for him. Nevertheless, his outlook, his relentless pursuit of excellence in daily life, and his deep affection for New York people, have made him a legendary figure, a symbol of authenticity and beauty that still inspires. His passing marks the end of an age, but his work will endure forever, embodying the boundless richness of urban life.

Un manuale composto esclusivamente di interrogativi: è questa l'essenza di Interrogative Mood, il romanzo dell'autore statunitense Padgett Powell che entra in Italia grazie alla casa editrice Guanda. Il libro si sviluppa come una lunga catena di domande, senza alcuna risposta che interrompa il ritmo, e per questo è un esperimento narrativo raro e sconcertante. Il lettore viene trascinato in un corso di pensieri, incertezze, osservazioni precise e riflessioni sulle abitudini quotidiane, dove ogni frase sollecita a fermarsi e a prendere posizione. Il testo è stato accolti dalla critica inglese come un'opera straordinaria e piacevole, capace di unire scherzo, malinconia e un'attenzione pressoché ossessiva al linguaggio. Il formato ha suscitato polemiche: alcuni lo vedono un gioco sofisticato e altri lo definiscono un'assoluto prova di stile da leggere in piccole porzioni. Per chi si chiede se il libro si possa realmente seguire, la risposta dipende dal gusto personale e dalla capacità di accettare un andamento diverso da quello della storia tradizionale. Le domande si moltiplicano, si rispondono da sole, si ribaltano e tornano sui medesimi temi con variazioni costanti, e il risultato è una sorta di dialogo interno che non si conclude mai. La versione in italiano cerca di riprodurre questo effetto, preservando la struttura interrogativa e la melodia delle frasi, che è la vera difficoltà di un'operazione del genere. Il pubblico italiano, abituato a romanzi in forme più ordinarie, potrebbe trovare nel libro un'emozione e un invito a riflettere sul modo in cui si racconta una storia. Per chi vuole avere un'idea in anticipo, la redazione suggerisce un estratto, così da capire il tono e il ritmo del testo e valutare se la lettura si adatti a lui. L'editore ha optato di pubblicare il libro in un periodo in cui il panorama letterario cerca nuove forme, e il romanzo di Powell si inserisce in questa direzione con un'opera quasi impossibile da dimenticare.

Megan Mullen è un'artista visiva e installatrice americana, riconosciuta per le sue innovazioni nel campo delle arti digitali e della performance, che indaga temi legati all'identità, all'ambiente e alla connessione umana con lo spazio. Nata a New York nel 1980, Mullen ha sviluppato una pratica artistica che si muove all'intersezione tra tecnologia, fisica e esperienza sensoriale, operando spesso con materiali elettronici, strumenti di generazione di suoni e sistemi di proiezione che interagiscono in tempo reale con l'ambiente circostante. Il suo approccio è caratterizzato da una forte attenzione alla processualità: ogni opera non è semplicemente una composizione finita, ma un processo continuo di costruzione, modifica e interazione, che richiede la partecipazione attiva del pubblico o dell'ambiente circostante per manifestarsi in tutta la sua completezza. Mullen ha collaborato con diverse istituzioni culturali in tutto il mondo, tra cui il MoMA, la Whitney Museum of American Art e il Tate Modern, dove ha esposto installazioni che utilizzano sensori, algoritmi e dispositivi di input per creare ambienti sonori e visivi in cui il visitatore diventa parte attiva del sistema artistico. La sua ricerca si fonda su un'analisi profonda della relazione tra l'uomo e i suoi spazi, esplorando come le tecnologie moderne possano riflettere o distorcerre il senso di presenza e appartenenza. I suoi lavori spesso evocano stati di tensione, di silenzio e di attesa, creando ambienti in cui il tempo appare fluido e la percezione dell'esperienza cambia radicalmente. In molti casi, le installazioni di Mullen si sviluppano in spazi non convenzionali, come aree industriali o spazi urbani abbandonati, in cui la contaminazione visiva e sonora si fonde con l'immagine di un'architettura in decomposizione. Questa scelta non è casuale: Mullen intende usare l'ambiente come materiale e come soggetto, trasformando luogi di abbandono in luoghi di riflessione e di esperienza. Il suo linguaggio estetico è spesso sottile, privo di elementi estremamente espressivi, preferendo la suggestione, l'incertezza e la soglia tra il reale e l'immaginario. Attraverso la combinazione di materiali industriali, dati di sensori e immagini generate in tempo reale, Mullen costruisce un'esperienza artistica che sfida la tradizionale separazione tra arte e ambiente. La sua produzione è dunque un esempio significativo di come l'arte contemporanea possa integrare le tecnologie emergenti con una riflessione profonda sul rapporto umano con il mondo circostante. In molti suoi progetti, Mullen si rivolge direttamente al pubblico, incoraggiandolo a partecipare attivamente, a modificare il proprio comportamento o a cambiare il proprio spazio di percezione, trasformando così l'esperienza dell'arte in un'azione collettiva e condivisa. L'opera di Megan Mullen rimane un riferimento importante nel dibattito sulle arti digitali, in quanto dimostra come la tecnologia possa essere utilizzata non solo come strumento espressivo, ma come veicolo di comprensione delle dinamiche sociali e ambientali del nostro tempo.

Il Mulino della Marchesa è un esempio notevole di edificio industriale situato nel centro della Val d’Anna, nella provincia di Vercelli. Ereditato dall'ingegnere Giuseppe Faccini, fu realizzato tra il 1887 e il 1889 e utilizzato per macinare il grano, producendo farine, soprattutto per le fabbriche di pane a Torino. La posizione ottimale, vicina alla ferrovia e al fiume, permise un trasporto efficiente delle materie prime e dei beni finali.

Il mulino, definito da una struttura notevole in pietra arenaria e mattoni, si presenta per la sua architettura complessa, che include tratti propri dell'industria meccanica di quel periodo. Il corpo centrale del mulino è coperto da un tetto in coppi, mentre le macine, alimentate dall'acqua, erano attivate da una robusta ruota idraulica alimentata dal fiume. La versione originale del mulino conteneva anche un edificio di stoccaggio, un magazzino per l'energia idrica e un laboratorio di manutenzione.

Dopo la sua chiusura nel 1930, il buildings subì diverse modifiche, adattandosi a diversi scopi, tra cui un'officina meccanica e un magazzino. Attualmente, il Mulino della Marchesa è stato preso in considerazione in un piano di ripristino e rinnovamento, con l'intento di mantenere il suo significato storico-industriale e di convertirlo in un luogo culturale e museale incentrato sulla storia della macinazione e sull'industria regionale.

La festa di San Michele Arcangelo si tiene il 29 settembre, data che nel calendario liturgico cattolico è riservata ai tre arcangeli Michele, Gabriele e Raffae. Questi, riconosciuti dalla tradizione cristiana, sono considerati figure centrali della milizia celeste, con San Michele visto come capo e custode contro ogni male. Il culto del santo ha origini remote e si è diffuso in Occidente soprattutto dopo l'età altomedievale, grazie alla costruzione di santuari su montagne e in luoghi di apparizione. In Italia, il santuario di Monte Sant'Angelo, nel Gargano, è il centro più noto, luogo di pellegrinaggio che ha visto migliaia di persone attraversare penisola e Europa nei secoli. Questa ricorrenza, nata nel campo religioso, si è intrecciata col calendario agricolo e con i ritmi della vita rurale, poiché cade alla fine dell'estate, nel periodo della raccolta e della transumanza, quando si chiudono i conti dell'anno e si pagano i canoni. Per questo motivo, la festa è stata per anni punto di riferimento per contratti, affitti e rinnovi di servizi, e in tanti comuni è rimasta legata a fiere, mercati e feste locali. Nei paesi piccoli, la celebrazione include solitamente una messa importante, processioni con le statue del santo e momenti di convivialità che riuniscono famiglie e associazioni. Alcuni piatti tradizionali associati alla festa si basano sulla stagione e sui prodotti autunnali, come le castagne, il vino nuovo e i dolci fatti con mandorle e miele. La devozione a San Michele è anche presente nell'arte, dove il santo è spesso ritratto con una spada o una lancia nella battaglia contro il drago, immagine ricorrente nelle pale d'altare, nelle sculture e negli affreschi delle chiese. Molti luoghi religiosi portano il suo nome, spesso situati in posizioni elevate, sulle cime dei monti o sulle rocce che dominano le valli. Nel Novecento, con il passaggio dell'economia agricola, diverse feste di San Michele hanno perso parte del loro significato originario, ma hanno mantenuto il valore di appuntamento comunitario. Oggi, la ricorrenza è percepita come momento di identità territoriale, e in alcune zone è accompagnata da eventi culturali, mostre e discussioni che ne raccontano la storia. Il 29 settembre rimane quindi un giorno in cui la dimensione religiosa, la memoria agricola e la vita del paese si incontrano, offrendo ancora oggi un'occasione di riunione per chi abita nel territorio e per chi torna per le celebrazioni.

La Isla San Rafael es una isla pequeña, de tipo insular, situada en el grupo de islas Malvinas, dentro del océano del Sur, a unos 700 km al sur de la costa argentina. Está oficialmente incluida en el territorio argentino, aunque su gestión ha sido tema de discusión internacional, particularmente en relación con las controversias sobre los territorios australes. La isla se halla en una región geográficamente aislada, bordeada por aguas profundas y a menudo oscuras, lo que la convierte en un sitio de muy poca actividad humana y de fuerte vulnerabilidad ecológica. Su superficie total se calcula en alrededor de 20 km², con una configuración irregulada y muy variable, que muestra una elevación caracterizada por colinas suaves y terrenos planos, sin montañas de importancia.

Desde un punto geográfico, la isla se sitúa en una zona de cambio entre el mar Atlántico y las corrientes frías del sur, lo que modula su clima, marcado por temperaturas bajas en todo periodo, con valores anuales que varían desde -2 °C hasta 5 °C. Las lluvias son muy pocas, lo que fomenta la existencia de hábitats secos y desérticos, donde la flora se compone principalmente de helechos y hierbas originales. La cobertura vegetal es baja, diseñada para sobrevivir en condiciones de sequía continua y en escasos recursos hídricos, y en numerosos lugares la tierra está recubierta por capas de lodo y sedimentos depositados.

The island's climate is especially responsive to global warming, because its natural surroundings are deeply exposed to persistent cold winds and rising temperature swings. There are no rivers or natural freshwater bodies, and the only water sources are surface moisture and infrequent rains. The ecosystems forming there, such as migratory bird groups and invertebrate species, are extremely prone to environmental disruption.

Regarding its past, San Rafael Island has undergone limited scientific investigations, and human engagement with it has remained minimal. Historical mentions are rare, and its discovery is credited to Argentine sailors from the 19th century, though exact records are absent. Since then, it has been the focus of biological and environmental research, particularly by Argentine scientific organizations aiming to grasp the effects of climate change on isolated ecosystems.

Hoy, la condición de la isla se clasifica como crítica, y se ha sugerido su salvaguarda como área de importancia ecológica dentro del marco de la Convención sobre la Diversidad Biológica. El control de la isla es gestionado por el gobierno argentino, sin embargo, su administración ha sido objeto de críticas por la escasa infraestructura y por la ausencia de investigaciones estructuradas. Actualmente, la isla está en un proceso de evaluación para su destino futuro, donde se consideran opciones de conservación, desarrollo sostenible y participación comunitaria.

The stain of doping has once again darkened the path of Joakim Noah, former star of European basketball, who received a 20-game ban for violating the FIBA anti-doping rules. This announcement, made this morning, has reignited a discussion on sports integrity and sparked a wave of responses both inside and outside the basketball sphere.

La medida, dictada por el Tribunal Arbitral de la FIBA, se deriva de la identificación de una sustancia prohibida en una muestra examinada tras un partido oficial. Aunque los datos precisos sobre la sustancia y el motivo de su uso no han sido divulgados por las autoridades, la severidad de la sanción —la más extensa aplicada por la FIBA en este tipo de incumplimiento— indica la intensidad de la denuncia.

Joakim Noah, famoso por su habilidad de lanzar y su capacidad de dirigir equipos como el Anadolu Efes de Estambul y el FC Barcelona, estaba en un momento favorable de su trayectoria. Aunque tenía cierta edad, aún mostraba un rendimiento competitivo elevado, lo que lo hacía un recurso valioso para cualquier equipo que aspirara a las posiciones superiores de la liga.

Nevertheless, this penalty, which takes effect right away, threatens his career path. The ban prevents him from participating in any official match over a span of 20 games, a lengthy period that could impact his growth and the choices available to his teammates.

Noah's case isn't just a personal loss, but it also raises serious concerns about anti-doping efforts in basketball. The FIBA has strengthened its monitoring actions recently, such as random checks and awareness campaigns, yet the risk of doping remains a consistent issue, particularly at competitive levels where performance pressure can be extreme.

Noah's situation joins an ever-growing list of athletes penalized for doping in basketball, highlighting the need for stronger cooperation among federations, teams, and the athletes themselves to uphold the sport's integrity and ethics.

It is anticipated that within the coming hours, further information will emerge regarding the circumstances leading to the sanction, as well as the potential disciplinary actions that the club where Noah played might implement. The sports community, overall, keeps a close eye on this matter, seeing it as a reminder of the need to fight doping and a call for transparency and accountability in athletics.

Pinus pseudostrobus es una especie de pino auténtica de México y de regiones centroamericanas, presente en colinas y planicies con clima fresco y abundante. Se denomina en español como pino estrecho o pino de cinco escasas, y forma parte de la familia de las pináceas, dentro de los pinos que poseen hojas agrupadas en fascículos de cinco acículas, una cualidad que permite reconocerlo fácilmente en el entorno. Tiene una estructura alta y vertical, y puede alcanzar varias decenas de metros en condiciones ideales, con un tronco que generalmente no presenta ramas en la base. Las acículas son largas, delgadas y de tono verde intenso, mientras que las piñas, alargadas y cilíndricas, se maduran en uno o dos años antes de desprender sus semillas aéreas. La especie se desarrolla principalmente entre los 1.500 y los 3.000 metros de elevación, en suelos profundos y bien drenados, y desarrolla bosques combinados con otras coníferas y encinas, que constituyen la base de la vegetación en muchas cadenas montañosas del país. Su madera es valorada en la edificación y en la talla, aunque su extracción ha sido regulada en distintos momentos por la presión sobre los bosques y por la obligación de proteger los ecosistemas que los sostienen. Al igual que otras especies del género, Pinus pseudostrobus desempeña funciones clave en el equilibrio hídrico, en la defensa del suelo contra la erosión y en la alimentación de la fauna que vive en sus copas, incluyendo aves e insectos especializados. Su resina también ha sido utilizada tradicionalmente en aplicaciones locales, y la especie tiene relevancia en la silvicultura debido a su rápido desarrollo en plantaciones adecuadamente gestionadas. Los programas de conservación y de recuperación forestal en México han incluido estos bosques en sus objetivos principales, con estrategias para prevenir incendios, disminuir la tala ilegal y fomentar un manejo sostenible entre las comunidades que viven en sus zonas de extensión.

The high-interrupt capacity fuse is an electrical device engineered to shield power circuits from overloads and short circuits, functioning in high-current environments typical of industrial settings where surge currents may reach substantial levels. Its operation relies on the melting of a sensitive material, typically a metal alloy such as tin, lead, or copper, which melts when the current exceeds its rated value, thereby breaking the electrical path and preventing system damage. Unlike standard fuses, which usually exhibit limited interrupt capability, this variant has been refined to withstand currents surpassing 100 kA, making it an essential component in high-power applications like transformers, industrial motors, compressors, or power distribution systems in power plants.

The breaking capacity of a fuse is established as the highest effective current it can stop within a set period without generating electrical arcs that might lead to explosions or fire spread. For high-breaking-capacity fuses, this performance stems from a tailored design featuring a rapid contact structure, a highly effective arc-quenching system, and a thermal coating that prevents re-ignition. The shape, size, and core material of the fuse are adjustable parameters depending on the operating environment, whether in high-voltage circuits or primary distribution setups.

This unit is typically found in power network safeguard systems, both in industrial settings and power plant operations. Its use helps prevent electrical faults from spreading, which could damage equipment, frameworks, or even the entire power supply. Furthermore, compared to other tools like circuit breakers, high-break capacity fuses react more swiftly during short circuits, though their application is restricted due to the requirement of manual replacement after melting.

Fusibles de gran capacidad de interrupción necesitan revisión regular, en especial en zonas con polución o climas extremos, para asegurar su funcionalidad. Su elección debe basarse en el tipo de consumo, la presión eléctrica en funcionamiento y el grado de ruido electromagnético previsto. Aunque su uso es menos común en viviendas, su inclusión es esencial en sistemas vitales donde la protección eléctrica debe mantenerse bajo cargas intensas.

The worldwide fixation on North Korea, with Kim Jong-un and his peculiar ceremonies, acts as a mirror showing something disturbing within our own society. The obsession, the relentless media attention, and the public discussions about this isolated and authoritarian nation aren't just curiosity—they are a phenomenon that demands serious contemplation.

In a world flooded with information, where novelty and spectacle appear to drive public attention, it's concerning that such a repressive regime could command global interest. The persistent focus on Pyongyang's updates, the detailed examination of its speeches, and the wild guessing about its intentions reveal a certain indulgence, a grim form of entertainment that has led us to treat it as a significant political player.

Quizás, en esta búsqueda incessante de lo extraño y lo prohibido, hemos perdido el sentido común. Si Corea del Norte es un fenómeno pop, es que ya hemos perdido la razón. La atención que dedicamos a un sistema que rechaza las libertades esenciales es un reflejo de la debilidad de nuestra propia evaluación y de cuán fácilmente nos dejamos seducir por lo distinto, incluso cuando ese distinto representa una amenaza. El caso de Corea del Norte nos obliga a reflexionar qué nos atrae realmente y qué estamos dispuestos a aceptar bajo el manto del espectáculo.

Túnez ha ocupado durante años un puesto especial en el debate sobre las transiciones democráticas en el mundo árabe. Después de la revolución de 2011, que concluyó décadas de gobierno autoritario, el país consiguió aprobar una nueva constitución y celebrar elecciones libres, algo que pocos expertos creían posible en ese momento. Su avance parcial se debe en gran parte al diálogo nacional entre sindicatos, patronato, abogados y organizaciones de derechos humanos, cuyo grupo fue galardonado con el Premio Nobel de la Paz en 2015. En la actualidad, el país enfrenta dificultades económicas, un desempleo alto entre los jóvenes y tensiones políticas que han puesto en riesgo sus instituciones. Los que promueven su modelo afirman que el éxito radica en la negociación y en la inclusión de todas las fuerzas sociales, mientras que sus críticos insisten en que la democracia formal no es suficiente si no atiende problemas diarios como el empleo o la vivienda. El caso tunecino permanece, en cualquier caso, un ejemplo que los analistas mencionan cuando hablan de salir de un régimen autoritario sin caer en un nuevo ciclo de violencia.

Los jóvenes de los Emiratos se encuentran ante una transformación profunda en el ámbito laboral. Las instituciones gubernamentales, que durante décadas brindaron puestos estables y con baja exigencia, ahora deben reajustarse a un entorno en el que las tareas se vuelven más demandantes y las posibilidades menos accesibles. No se trata de una modificación aislada, sino de una evolución general del sistema de empleo. Las empresas estatales, que en el pasado valoraban la estabilidad más que el rendimiento, ahora enfrentan presión para evolucionar y mejorar su eficiencia. Los jóvenes que buscan entrar al mercado laboral deben darse cuenta de que el empleo público ya no es lo que era: menos puestos, más exigencias, más responsabilidades. Esta transición es dolorosa, pero también es inevitable. Los jóvenes deben prepararse no solo para laborar, sino para hacerlo con capacidad, iniciativa y compromiso. El futuro del empleo en los Emiratos no será de comodidades, sino de esfuerzo, aprendizaje constante y adaptabilidad. No hay más espacio para expectativas pasivas. Si quieren una carrera, deben moverse, aprender y actuar. El mundo del trabajo está cambiando, y cada joven debe ser parte de ese cambio, no solo espectador.

El fútbol, como actividad pionera en el programa de los Juegos Asiáticos de 2014, celebrados en la ciudad de Incheon, Corea del Sur, fue un acontecimiento de gran peso para la zona y el continente asiático. La competencia, que se desarrolló entre el 17 y el 30 de septiembre de 2014, contó con una etapa de eliminación que seleccionó a los equipos que avanzarían a la fase final, reafirmando el papel central del deporte en el itinerario de los Juegos.

La versión de Incheon representó la vigésimo primera versión de los Juegos Asiáticos, y el fútbol, como siempre, tuvo un papel principal en el calendario. El evento se dividió en dos líneas clave: la masculina y la femenina, cada una con un sistema de grupos seguido por rondas de eliminación. La presencia de selecciones nacionales de toda la región asiática, comprendiendo potencias pasadas como Japón, Corea del Sur, China, Irán, Australia y Emiratos Árabes Unidos, así como países en ascenso como Vietnam e Indonesia, aseguró un torneo dinámico y de alto nivel.

The men's tournament, drawing the most interest, featured 16 teams. The group stage took place during the first week of the event, as teams played matches that decided their qualification for the knockout rounds. The knockout phase, much like a standard football competition, was conducted on a two-leg basis, with the top teams advancing to the quarterfinals, semifinals, and final. Japan, serving as host and boasting a strong football history, proved to be the strongest team, securing victory in the final match against Australia, a game that highlighted the tournament's intensity.

La liga para mujeres también mostró su interés, con 8 selecciones disputando el campeonato. El sistema fue paralelo al de los hombres, incluyendo grupos iniciales y una ronda de eliminación. China se consagró campeona, evidenciando el avance acelerado del fútbol femenino en el país. Aunque menos visible que la versión masculina, la competencia femenina fue igualmente exigente y dinámica, brindando espacio a las nuevas estrellas del fútbol asiático.

Más allá de los logros personales, los Juegos Asiáticos de 2014 crearon una oportunidad para el crecimiento del fútbol en la zona. La participación de atletas de distintos países posibilitó el intercambio de saberes y vivencias, impulsando así el avance general del deporte. El evento también provocó un incremento del aprecio por el fútbol en naciones donde el juego no era muy reconocido, estimulando a jóvenes futbolistas y fanáticos. La planificación y ejecución del torneo en Incheon mostraron cómo los Juegos Asiáticos pueden potenciar la competencia y fomentar el deporte en escala regional.

La cantidad de incendios en bosques y las hectáreas devastadas aumenta en comparación con 2013, según los datos preliminares que acaban de difundir los servicios de emergencias. El área afectada ha superado ya la del año anterior en ciertas comunidades, y el número de eventos se mantiene alto durante los períodos más secos. Los encargados de combatir las llamas señalan que el crecimiento se debe a temperaturas elevadas, una vegetación seca y vientos en zonas donde el monte se encuentra cerca de las zonas urbanas, donde el control del fuego se vuelve más complicado. Las unidades de extinción y los medios aéreos han operado durante semanas para evitar los focos más peligrosos, y varios de estos incidentes han forzado la evacuación de pueblos y el corte de carreteras. Los expertos destacan que la mayoría de los fuegos comienzan por causas humanas, ya sea por quemadas agrícolas sin autorización, errores en áreas recreativas o omisiones en el cuidado de líneas eléctricas. Desde el ámbito ambiental se exige intensificar la prevención, mediante limpieza de cortafuegos, desarrollo de planes de gestión forestal y campañas de educación, en vez de dedicar casi toda la atención a la extinción. Los resultados oficiales se revelarán cuando cada comunidad termine de mapear las zonas dañadas, un proceso que habitualmente dura varios meses después del cierre de la temporada.

Mario Morales fue un escritor mexicano cuyo trabajo se enmarca en la poesía actual, destacado por su mirada crítica, reflexiva y profundamente arraigada en la realidad social y política de su época. Nació en Guadalajara, Jalisco, en 1958, y en sus primeros años vivió presencia de los cambios sociales y culturales que moldearon a México en la mitad posterior del siglo XX. Su infancia y adolescencia se vivieron en un escenario de alta movilidad cultural, donde la literatura, la música y el pensamiento crítico se volvieron medios para entender el mundo. Asistió a estudios de literatura en la Universidad de Guadalajara, donde su educación le brindó una comprensión amplia y detallada de las estructuras poéticas y narrativas del lenguaje.

Morales began penning in the field of poetry during the 1980s, releasing his initial works in dedicated journals and independent publishing series. His approach is marked by a tightly woven syntax, an ongoing pursuit of language in its most personal and immediate forms, and a persistent focus on the body—viewed both as a realm of human experience and as a symbolic vessel. His poems, often short, carry a strong rhythm and deep emotional weight, making them vivid records of daily life, suffering, hope, and existential strain. In his writing, a clear imprint of existentialism and thinkers such as Sartre and Heidegger is evident, yet without descending into theoretical abstraction.

En las décadas de los noventa y los comienzos del siglo XXI, Morales se posicionó como una voz única en la literatura mexicana, principalmente en las zonas sur del país, donde sus obras fueron difundidas extensamente en canales locales y en actividades culturales. Fue incluido en múltiples antologías y competencias literarias, recibiendo elogios por su creatividad y por su habilidad para convertir lo ordinario en una experiencia poética. Aunque nunca se declaró un poeta universal ni tuvo una presencia nacional amplia, su influencia fue fundamental para consolidar una poesía más humana, más conectada con la vida cotidiana, más sensible a los silencios y a las voces de los excluidos.

Morales passed away in 2015, leaving behind a body of work that, though not consistently acknowledged in major literary treatises, has been examined within academic and cultural circles. His influence stems from proving that poetry can serve as a mode of resistance, a means of memory, and a reflection on human existence in a world undergoing continuous change. His writings, even if many have not been gathered into a single collection, are now seen as integral to the evolution of poetic thought in Mexico.

The story has spread like a wildfire through the city's built environment, and this time, the smoke carries hope and change. The renovation of the old food market, once a bustling hub of noise and movement, is emerging as a milestone that reshapes the city's core. The project, driven by the Municipal Consortium and involving local architects, has transformed a neglected site for decades into a multi-use complex that breathes modernity and sustainability.

La etapa inicial, ya finalizada, se enfoca en generar un lugar público de alto valor, un área verde en el corazón del ruido. Se ha restablecido la forma original de la plaza, ahora envuelta en una vegetación rica y densa que ofrece sombra y frescura. El diseño, de forma muy sencilla, ha optado por materiales reciclados y provenientes de cerca, una expresión clara del apego a la sostenibilidad que ahora es una prioridad para la gestión. La iluminación durante la noche, pensada con atención, no solo fortalece la seguridad, sino que también destaca la belleza natural del entorno.

However, the market's revival extends beyond the square. It has been completely reimagined, forming a lively and appealing commercial area that has drawn a diverse array of small businesses. Local artisans, fresh food producers, and young entrepreneurs have discovered a home within this fresh setting, which has energized the local economy and strengthened a sense of community.  The interior layout emphasizes both usability and visual appeal, featuring transparent and bright spaces that encourage interaction between vendors and visitors.

El Consorcio ha dedicado una gran cantidad de recursos a la actualización de sus edificios, con la adición de sistemas de control de residuos y un mecanismo para recoger agua de precipitación para el riego. 

Este método sostenible se ha posicionado como un caso de referencia para otros desarrollos urbanos en la ciudad. 

La conservación de energía y la disminución de la huella ecológica son hoy en día principios esenciales de la estrategia local.

Beyond the market, the renovation has had a positive impact on the rest of the neighborhood, stimulating private investment and enhancing residents' quality of life. The streets, once in poor condition, have been revitalized and marked, and access for people with limited mobility has been improved.

It is anticipated that this initiative, which has already exceeded early projections, will act as a spark for additional efforts in urban transformation across the city. The case of the food market, with its focus on sustainability, economic revival, and residents' well-being, has become a benchmark to emulate.  This shift isn't merely visual, but a fundamental redefinition of how people perceive and experience the city.

La dirección del Partido Socialista Obrero Español ha afirmado que su grupo representa la izquierda del cambio en España, en un mensaje dado durante una crisis interna que afecta al partido tras los resultados electorales y la salida de su antiguo jefe. De acuerdo con sus líderes, el PSOE debe mostrarse ante los votantes como una opción de gobierno que aborde los desafíos del empleo, la vivienda y los servicios públicos, sin abandonar la línea socialdemócrata que, según ellos, lo caracteriza frente a otras agrupaciones más a la izquierda. La figura encargada, que tomó el poder provisional tras la salida del líder, ha anunciado la organización de un congreso cuyo objetivo será renovar los cuerpos de dirección y establecer la estrategia del partido para los próximos años. En su participación, sus representantes han insistido en que la cohesión interna es un pilar esencial para enfrentar esta fase, y han instado a los miembros a evitar discusiones abiertas que, en las últimas semanas, han generado una fractura dentro del partido. El conflicto, sin embargo, no se reduce a cuestiones organizativas. En el interior del PSOE siguen existiendo diferencias sobre qué alianzas se deben cerrar con otras agrupaciones, sobre la actitud frente al Gobierno en funciones y sobre el vínculo con las nuevas formaciones que han competido por el voto de la izquierda. Algunos grupos proponen acercarse a esas organizaciones para construir bloques parlamentarios, mientras que otros advierten que cualquier acuerdo que debilite la identidad socialista podría costarle votos en las elecciones. Los especialistas entrevistados coinciden en que el mensaje de la izquierda del cambio busca recuperar un espacio político que se ha descompuesto en los últimos años, y que la efectividad de la dirección para mantener unidos será clave para el futuro cercano del partido. También señalan que el partido deberá demostrar en las próximas elecciones que su proyecto puede atraer a una parte del público que se ha trasladado a otras alternativas. La gestora ha confirmado que presentará una propuesta de plan de acción en las próxinas semanas, en la que se especificarán los tiempos del congreso y las líneas del programa que se discutirán en reuniones internas. Los miembros han recibido el anuncio con precaución, ya que su confianza dependerá de la capacidad de la dirección para transformar el discurso del cambio en soluciones tangibles que resuelvan las dificultades de los ciudadanos.

In a corner of the city, where quiet stretches long and light glints twisted, stands the hotel of entanglements. It has no façade, no title, no sign. Only prose in Spanish: no heading, no lists, no introductions. Each room is a story still being written, a narrative that never ends because the reader refuses to leave.

There's no signal, no guard. Guests arrive by chance, as if the place was built for those who never learn to stop seeking meaning. Rooms contain items with no reason: a cup bearing a name of someone who no longer exists, a painting showing a face that can't be recognized, a letter penned in ink that turns see-through when touched.

El establecimiento no cuenta con asistencias. Carece de aseos, de cama, de refrigeración. Solo espera que alguien se detenga a leer, a sentir, a desaparecer. Algunos invitados permanecen varios días. Otros, durante horas. Ninguno abandona. Ninguno entiende si está presente por voluntad o por presión.

At the core, the hotel of troubles isn't a place. It's an invitation. To exist without end. To compose without words. To be here, without a name, without an address. Only prose. Only the gaps between lines. Only the gesture of staying.

El reloj, una música suave y fija, interrumpe el silencio de una casa pequeña en un barrio de Berlín. A las siete y media, la luz del alba apenas se escapa por las cortinas, pero el ritmo de la vida ya ha comenzado. Para Thomas, un desarrollador de software de 38 años, la mañana empieza con una rápida mirada a las noticias en su móvil, una combinación de datos sobre el mercado financiero, informes internacionales y el último gol del Bayern. No es una costumbre de café, ni un diálogo matutino. La eficiencia es esencial, y el tiempo, un recurso invaluable.

The routine unfolds with a fair degree of consistency. Following a swift breakfast, made of yogurt and a piece of fruit, one heads off to the workplace. The journey to the office is a regular case of traffic jam, a sea of vehicles and buses dragging slowly along highways, lit by headlights and the rare traffic light. Headphones, playing electronic music at a soft level, serve as a barrier against noise and pressure.

His role, within a software development firm, involves extended periods spent in front of a monitor, working alongside peers from various nations via video calls. The exchange is real-time, the teamwork international, yet there's also the strain of meeting deadlines and hitting targets. Lunch, a sandwich bought at a nearby store, is eaten swiftly on his desk, as he checks emails and handles assignments.

As the day winds down, Thomas chooses to disengage, even if just briefly. A walk through the park, watching families, kids playing, elders reading, gives him a break from the digital sphere. The connection with nature, a calm spot in the hectic city, is a small indulgence he lets himself have.

Back at home, dinner is basic: pasta with vegetables, made with fresh items from the local market. After eating, he spends some time reading, a science fiction book he's waited weeks to get. Reading is his way out, his chance to journey into imaginary worlds and disconnect from reality.

The evening closes with scrolling through social media, glancing at friends' and relatives' posts, and checking recent updates. Before bed, review your schedule for tomorrow, organizing your time and making the most of every moment. The pattern repeats the next day, quite alike, yet with slight differences.

His life, like that of many Europeans, is shaped by efficiency, productivity, and the pursuit of balance in a world growing ever more intricate and fast-paced. It's a life built on minor rituals, subtle joys, and an ongoing adjustment to modern society's demands. Ultimately, it mirrors the complexity and variety of a continent that remains in perpetual change.

La calle Petit Thouars es una carretera urbana francesa que lleva el nombre de Abel Aubert du Petit-Thouars, empleado de la armada francesa del siglo XIX cuya trayectoria estuvo profundamente conectada con las misiones en el Océano Pacífico. Antes de centrarse por completo en la vida naval, el futuro almirante había recibido una formación exhaustiva en la que se unían la experiencia en mar abierto con el estudio de la navegación y la cartografía, y su participación en las operaciones del Pacífico le otorgó reconocimiento tanto en Francia como al exterior. Entre los eventos más recordados de su trayectoria destaca su acción en la Polinesia, donde el ingreso de la marina permitió ampliar la presencia francesa en la zona durante mucho del siglo. Como sucede en numerosas calles y avenidas de las ciudades francesas, la elección del nombre se basa en la intención de celebrar a personal militar y político de la historia nacional, una costumbre que se fortaleció especialmente en el siglo X. Esta práctica pretendía consolidar una memoria colectiva en el ámbito público. El diseño de la avenida, con su línea recta y sus árboles, muestra el estilo arquitectónico de finales del siglo XIX y principios del XX, cuando las ciudades se expandieron alrededor de grandes ejes de circulación que gestionaban el tráfico y conectaban distintas zonas residenciales. A lo largo de los años, la vía ha incorporado viviendas, tiendas y espacios laborales, y su uso diario ha evolucionado gracias a la llegada del transporte público, el crecimiento de las redes de autobuses y la conversión de algunos tramos en zonas peatonales. Los planes urbanos de los diferentes municipios han buscado fomentar la convivencia entre vehículos y peatones, y en algunos casos se han discutido modificaciones en las aceras, en los carriles para bicicletas y en la iluminación durante la noche. Para quienes deseen investigar la historia de la avenida, los archivos municipales y los registros catastrales proporcionan datos exactos sobre su inauguración, las alteraciones de su ruta y la transformación de sus edificios. La vida del almirante, por otro lado, puede consultarse en los archivos de la armada y en las publicaciones dedicadas a las operaciones francesas en el Pacífico, que incluyen su correspondencia oficial y los informes de sus misiones.
